pages.text: All medical items can be used by opening the medical panel and selecting a body part. Items that do not require a specific part, such as blood packs, can be used directly with right-click.

pages.title: Blood Pack
pages.text: Use an empty blood pack on yourself or others to store blood. In emergencies, you can replenish blood volume instantly.$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Reduces blood loss (blood pack)$(li2)Increases blood loss (empty blood pack)$(br)$(li)Treats$(li2)Blood loss

pages.title: Morphine
pages.text: Use morphine on yourself or others to relieve pain.$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Increases analgesia$(li)Side Effects$(li2)Increases opioid addiction$(li2)Increases opioid toxicity$(br)$(li)Treats$(li2)Limb dysfunction, intense pain

pages.title: Bandage
pages.text: Use bandages to wrap wounds, stop bleeding, and stabilize dislocations.$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Stops bleeding (ineffective for internal injuries)$(li)Side Effects$(li2)Dirty bandages increase internal injuries$(li2)Reduces movement speed$(li)Primary Use$(li2)Burns$(li)Secondary Use$(li2)Open wounds, dislocations, fractures

pages.title: Suture
pages.text: Used to stitch torn skin back together.$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Stitches open wounds$(br)$(li)Treats$(li2)Open wounds

pages.title: Plaster Cast
pages.text: Apply plaster after bandaging to fix broken bones in place.$(br)$(li)Effects$(li2)Treats fractures$(li)Side Effects$(li2)Reduces movement speed$(li2)Removes fracture penalties$(br)$(li)Treats$(li2)Fractures
